This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, operational follow-up, coordination, and continuous improvement. The position is part of a structured cybersecurity and compliance programme in the context of NIS2 obligations under Belgian law and the implementation of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, with a target of April 2027. The consultant/employee will contribute directly to control implementation, evidence production, and audit readiness across the corporate IT perimeter.

• Contract type: open to freelance consultant or permanent employee, depending on profile
 
• Start date: as soon as possible
 
• Remote work: hybrid model with 2 days per week remote and 3 days on site
 
• Travel: no travel required
 
• Reporting line: Cybersec Operations Manager
 
• Working language: French for day-to-day team interactions, with professional English required for documentation, tools, and international stakeholders
 
• Team context: the IT Security team is being structured and scaled, in a build environment rather than a steady-state operation

Main responsibilities

Security operations & monitoring:

 
• Monitor and investigate security alerts across multiple security platforms
 
• Participate in incident response activities and support the coordination of security investigations
 
• Improve and tune detection capabilities and monitoring use cases
 
• Support the development and maintenance of operational security procedures and playbooks
 
• Perform operational security reviews and follow-up activities

Vulnerability & exposure management:

 
• Coordinate vulnerability scanning activities and ensure findings are reviewed and prioritized
 
• Follow up remediation actions with infrastructure, platform, application, and support teams
 
• Track remediation progress and escalate overdue actions when required
 
• Coordinate external penetration tests and security assessments
 
• Ensure findings from assessments and pentests are documented, tracked, and remediated

Security assessments & risk management:

 
• Perform security reviews of applications, services, and technical solutions
 
• Contribute to risk assessments for new projects, technologies, and providers
 
• Review security configurations and identify improvement opportunities
 
• Support the identification and management of security risks across the IT environment

Security governance & reporting:

 
• Maintain and monitor operational security KPIs and dashboards
 
• Support reporting related to vulnerabilities, incidents, security posture, and remediation efforts
 
• Participate in periodic reviews of user access, privileged accounts, and security controls
 
• Contribute to compliance activities and implementation of security requirements related to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIS2
 
• Produce and maintain auditable evidence of security control operations, including logs, reports, review records, and remediation closure evidence

Security improvement & automation:

 
• Identify opportunities to improve security controls and operational processes
 
• Contribute to...
...

Experience:

• Minimum 3 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, vulnerability management, or a related technical security role

• Experience in security monitoring, incident handling, or vulnerability management

• Experience working with security tools and operational security processes

 

Technical knowledge:

• Understanding of security monitoring and incident response principles

• Knowledge of vulnerability management processes and risk-based remediation prioritization, including CVSS scores, asset criticality, exploitability context, and compensating controls

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR suite: Defender for EndPoint, Defender for Office 365 / Exchange Online Protection, and Defender for Identity

• Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel or an equivalent SIEM platform; deployment experience is a strong asset

• Understanding of Entra ID governance, including Conditional Access, Identity Protection, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM)

• Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Purview

• Understanding of network security fundamentals, including Firewall management with Palo Alto or FortiGate, log forwarding, and network segmentation principles

• Familiarity with security frameworks and best practices such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls

 

Personal skills:

• Organized, structured, and detail-oriented

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams

• Curious, proactive, and willing to continuously learn new technologies and security trends

• Strong communication and coordination skills

• Practical and solution-oriented team player

 

Languages:

• Fluent French

• Professional English required

 

Nice to have certifications

• SC-200 — Microsoft Security Operations Analyst

• SC-300 — Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator

• CompTIA Security+ or Cysa+

Client Details

Our client is an international company specialized in medical supplies and accessories.

A successful Customer Service DACH for the medical sector should have:

• Knowledge of customer service processes and tools.
• Experience in SAP is a big plus
• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Customer-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills.

Do you enjoy problem-solving, adapting to new situations and communicating with people from different countries? Then we have a great challenge for you!
 

We are looking for a motivated Customer Service Assistant for an innovative transport company in Schelle (Antwerp) who can communicate fluently in English, Polish and German.
 

You’ll be a key link within the logistics department. Working with various partners and sites, you’ll ensure that return shipments are collected smoothly, efficiently and on time. No two days are the same: you’ll plan, coordinate, follow up and step in when things don’t go to plan.
 

Your mission?
 

To ensure that every collection runs as smoothly as possible. You’ll maintain an overview, liaise with the relevant parties and spot potential issues before they become real problems.
 

In practical terms, this means that you:
 

• Plan and organise collections by creating weekly schedules and maintaining contact with the relevant partners and locations.
 

• Actively track which locations have not yet been contacted and ensure that no collection slips through the net.
 

• Monitor performance and help devise solutions when a collection does not go to plan.
 

• Keep customer details up to date, from telephone numbers and email addresses to opening hours and other practical information.
 

• Continuously look for smart ways to increase the success rate of collections.

Can you tick off the following points? Then you’re the Customer Service we’re looking for!
 
 

• • You’re multilingual. You communicate fluently in English, Polish and German and feel at ease in an international working environment. 

• Transport and logistics appeal to you. Experience is a bonus, but not essential. Your motivation, eagerness to learn and interest in the sector are just as important. 

• You’re curious and keen to learn. You pick up new information quickly and have an interest in transport and logistics. 

• You like structure. You work in an organised manner and ensure your records are kept clearly, transparently and efficiently. 

• You take the initiative. You don’t always wait for someone to tell you what needs doing, but contribute your own ideas and aren’t afraid to take action. 

• You’re confident and self-assured. Even when things don’t go to plan, you stay calm, focus on solutions and aren’t afraid to make decisions. 

• You’re a real team player. You enjoy working with others, help colleagues where needed and bring a positive vibe to the team with your energy. 

• You have your own transport and can get to Schelle with ease.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium

• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

About Us
Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating innovative, effective, and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high levels of productivity. Positioned at the forefront of innovative and sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to cultivate healthy products and enhance their yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job description
We are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented Accounting, Controlling & Billing Officer to join our growing team at Zymofix. You will play a key role in keeping our financial operations running smoothly and accurately as we scale.
 

The ideal candidate combines solid accounting knowledge with a strong controlling mindset and a keen eye for accurate billing and invoicing. You thrive in a dynamic startup environment where initiative and versatility are valued. You will work closely with management and act as the go-to person for financial administration, controlling, and billing.
 

The role requires strong organizational skills, a high degree of autonomy, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
 

 
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 

• Manage day-to-day accounting tasks including accounts payable/receivable, invoicing, bank reconciliations, and expense tracking. 

• Own the billing cycle end-to-end: generate and send customer invoices, monitor payment terms, follow up on outstanding balances, and resolve billing discrepancies. 

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and support the annual audit process. 

• Develop and maintain controlling processes, including cost tracking, margin analysis, and variance reporting against budget. 

• Ensure compliance with local tax regulations and assist with VAT filings and other statutory obligations. 

• Support budgeting and forecasting processes in close collaboration with management. 

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records in the accounting system. 

• Monitor cash flow and support working capital management. 

• Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, and reporting efficiency. 
 

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 

• Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in an accounting, controlling, or billing role. 

• Solid knowledge of Belgian accounting standards and VAT regulations. 

• Proficiency with accounting software (e.g., Allegro or similar) and MS Office (Excel in particular). 

• Experience with Notion is a plus. 

• High level of accuracy, discretion, and organizational skills. 

• You are a proactive self-starter who can work independently in a fast-moving environment. 

• Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail, particularly around numbers and financial data. 

• Excellent communication skills, verbal and written in Dutch and English (French is a plus).
